limits: Live cross-provider inference was verified with SDK Opus and Codex GPT-6.1 Sol, not every provider or SDK model.
The local-rejection case replays synthetic legacy error entries; it does not send prompts to or modify a production conversation.
Only the newly added Pi turns are sent as context data; no native SDK transcript is reconstructed and no completed tools are automatically replayed.
SDK history before its completed checkpoint must still match; prompt, tools, explicit environment and output cap remain fixed.
Unknown SDK failures, interrupted SDK tools and incomplete foreign tool batches are not automatically recovered.
Native SDK compaction remains disabled; arbitrary SDK histories without their checkpoint are not recovered.
Existing workers need replacement to load the change.
Mobile Chromium is not physical iPhone/Safari or configured opentunnel inference verification.
Costs are SDK estimates, not billing or subscription-balance measurements.
No credentials were copied and personal settings stayed unchanged. The shared host was not restarted.
The full repository suite and CI results were not checked.
